### Why Most Verification Tools Assume You Have Developers (and Why That Fails)


The employee verification industry in India has a developer problem. The most commonly recommended platforms — SurePass, Gridlines (Perfios), IDfy, Bureau.id — are built as API-first tools. They require a developer to write integration code, build a user interface, handle error responses, and maintain the system over time.


This makes sense for tech companies with engineering teams. It does not make sense for the **63 million MSMEs in India** where the HR function is handled by the business owner, an office manager, or a single HR generalist who has never written a line of code.


The consequences of this developer dependency are real:


- AuthBridge’s H1 FY26 report found a **4.33% discrepancy rate** across white-collar hires in India
- Their H2 2025 data showed **18.8% of candidates misrepresented** at least one credential
- EY India discovered **32% of flagged candidates had listed employers that did not exist** in government records
- OnGrid’s FY 2024-25 report documented **3.6 lakh BGV failures** across their platform


These businesses face the same hiring fraud risks as large enterprises, but the tools designed to solve the problem require technical resources they do not have.


This blog reviews **6 employee verification platforms that work without any API integration, developer setup, or technical knowledge** . Every tool on this list can be used by an HR manager, office admin, or business owner directly from a web browser.


**What you will find in this blog:**


- A side-by-side comparison of all 6 platforms on technical requirements, pricing, and checks
- Detailed review of each platform’s setup process and HR-friendliness
- A technical setup comparison matrix
- What you actually give up (and gain) by choosing no-API platforms
- A decision framework based on your team’s technical capability
- 10 FAQs answered


[Try SalaryBox Verify — Zero Technical Setup, Rs. 499 Per Candidate](https://salarybox.in/verify/)

### 1. SalaryBox Verify — Best No-Developer Verification Platform for Any Business


**Website:**[salarybox.in/verify](https://salarybox.in/verify/)


**Pricing:** Rs. 499 per candidate (flat rate, all checks included)


**Technical Setup Required:** None — sign up and run your first check in 5 minutes


**Checks Covered:** PAN verification (Income Tax Department), Voter ID verification (Election Commission), Driving Licence verification (Parivahan/Sarathi), UAN/EPFO past employment history


**Why SalaryBox Verify Ranks First:**


SalaryBox Verify was designed from the ground up for non-technical users. There is no API documentation to read, no developer console to configure, no webhook endpoints to set up, and no integration code to write. The entire verification process runs from a standard web browser.


Here is what makes it the best choice for teams without developers:


- **5-minute setup:** Create an account at salarybox.in/verify and run your first verification immediately. No sales call, no demo, no onboarding process, no technical configuration.
- **Browser-based workflow:** Enter the candidate’s details, select which government database checks you need, confirm the Rs. 499 billing, and receive results in seconds. The entire workflow happens in your browser — exactly like filling out an online form.
- **Instant government database results:** Every check queries official government databases directly — Income Tax Department for PAN, Election Commission for Voter ID, Parivahan for DL, EPFO for employment history. Results arrive in seconds, not days.
- **PDF reports ready for HR files:** Results are exported as downloadable PDFs with sensitive identifiers (full PAN, etc.) partially masked. No additional formatting or redaction needed.
- **Automatic cross-referencing:** The platform compares identity signals (name, date of birth) across multiple government databases, flagging mismatches automatically. On API platforms, your developer would need to build this logic manually.
- **Private workspace with search:** Every check is stored in a searchable, private workspace. Pull up any candidate’s verification history at any time without digging through emails or spreadsheets.


**What makes it different from API platforms:**


API platforms like SurePass and Gridlines give you raw building blocks — individual database endpoints that return JSON data. Your developer assembles these into a usable verification workflow. SalaryBox Verify gives you the finished product: a complete workflow that runs all checks, cross-references results, and generates reports — without touching code.


**Real-world scenario:** A 25-person accounting firm in Chennai hires 3-4 junior accountants per quarter. Their office manager handles hiring alongside payroll and admin work. She has never used an API in her life. With SalaryBox Verify, she enters each candidate’s PAN and UAN, pays Rs. 499, and gets an instant report confirming their identity and employment history. Total time per candidate: 3-5 minutes. No developer needed at any step.


**Best for:** Any business in India — retail, services, logistics, healthcare, education, professional services — where the person responsible for hiring does not have technical skills and needs reliable verification without IT support.

### 2. SpringVerify — Self-Serve BGV Dashboard for Startups


**Pricing:** Rs. 799-1,599 per candidate (Basic, Standard, Premium tiers)


**Technical Setup Required:** None for dashboard use (API available optionally for tech teams)


**Checks Covered:** PAN, Voter ID, Driving Licence, UAN/EPFO (reference-based), criminal records, education verification, address verification, reference checks


**Strengths:**


- **Broadest check coverage without developers:** SpringVerify covers identity, employment, criminal, education, and address checks — all accessible through a web dashboard without any API integration. This is the broadest check portfolio among no-developer platforms.
- **Candidate-initiated document upload:** Send candidates a link to upload their own documents. Reduces HR workload for document collection — the candidate does the data entry.
- **ATS integration without code:** Pre-built integrations with Zoho Recruit, Freshteam, and Lever that connect through simple dashboard toggles, not custom API code.
- **Clean dashboard design:** The web interface is designed for HR users, with status tracking, candidate timelines, and report downloads all accessible without technical knowledge.


**Limitations:**


- **60-220% more expensive than SalaryBox Verify:** The Basic plan at Rs. 799 covers fewer checks than what SalaryBox Verify includes at Rs. 499. For full coverage (criminal + education), you need the Rs. 1,599 Premium plan.
- **Not instant:** Criminal and education checks take 24-72 hours because they involve manual verification with courts and universities. Only identity checks are near-instant.
- **Employment verification relies on reference calls:** SpringVerify primarily verifies employment through calls to previous employers, not direct EPFO database queries. A candidate who provides a fake reference number can still pass. SalaryBox Verify’s EPFO check is harder to fool because government PF records cannot be fabricated.
- **Startup-oriented pricing:** Makes sense for VC-backed startups with hiring budgets. A bootstrapped SMB verifying 5 hires/month at Rs. 1,599 each spends Rs. 7,995/month vs. Rs. 2,495 with SalaryBox Verify.


**Best for:** Funded startups (Series A+) that need criminal record and education verification alongside identity checks, and have the budget for Rs. 799-1,599 per candidate.


**Verdict:** SpringVerify is the best no-developer option for businesses that specifically need criminal and education checks. For identity and employment verification alone (PAN, Voter ID, DL, EPFO), SalaryBox Verify delivers instant results at 38-69% lower cost.

### 3. AuthBridge iBridge Dashboard — Enterprise BGV With a Web Interface


**Pricing:** Rs. 1,500-3,000+ per candidate (annual contracts; varies by package)


**Technical Setup Required:** No coding, but 2-6 weeks of sales-led onboarding (demo, contract, account configuration)


**Checks Covered:** PAN, Voter ID, Driving Licence, UAN/EPFO, criminal records (600+ courts), education verification, address verification (field visits), reference checks, CIBIL/credit checks, global sanctions screening


**Strengths:**


- **Most comprehensive check coverage:** AuthBridge’s iBridge dashboard offers every verification type available in India — identity, employment, criminal, education, address, credit, and global sanctions — all accessible through a web interface without API integration.
- **Court record database:** Access to criminal records across 600+ district and high courts — a check no other non-developer platform on this list can offer.
- **India’s largest BGV provider:** 18+ years of operational history, millions of verifications processed annually. Enterprise-grade reliability and uptime.
- **No coding required for the dashboard:** Once onboarded, HR teams use the iBridge web dashboard to initiate checks, track progress, and download reports. The interface is designed for non-technical users.


**Limitations:**


- **2-6 weeks before your first check:** AuthBridge requires a sales demonstration, needs assessment, contract negotiation, and account configuration before you can run a single check. SalaryBox Verify takes 5 minutes. This is not a “technical” setup, but it is still a significant barrier for small businesses that need to verify a candidate next week.
- **Enterprise pricing:** Rs. 1,500-3,000+ per candidate with annual contracts and minimum volumes. Small businesses verifying 5-10 candidates per month are paying for enterprise infrastructure they do not need.
- **Sales call mandatory:** You cannot create an account and start verifying. Someone must speak with AuthBridge’s sales team before activation — a dealbreaker for business owners who want to solve the problem today, not in 3 weeks.
- **Bundled services inflate cost:** If you only need PAN, Voter ID, DL, and EPFO checks, you are paying Rs. 1,500-3,000 for a bundle that includes criminal, education, and address checks you may not require. SalaryBox Verify charges Rs. 499 for exactly the government database checks you need.


**Best for:** Large organisations (200+ employees) in regulated industries (BFSI, healthcare, IT services) that need the full spectrum of verification checks and can justify 2-6 weeks of onboarding and Rs. 1,500-3,000+ per candidate.


**Verdict:** AuthBridge offers the most comprehensive verification coverage through a no-code dashboard. But the weeks-long onboarding, enterprise pricing, and mandatory sales calls make it inaccessible for small businesses. For SMBs that need government database verification now, SalaryBox Verify delivers PAN, Voter ID, DL, and EPFO checks at Rs. 499 with a 5-minute setup.

### 4. DigiVerifier — AI-Assisted Verification Without Technical Integration


**Pricing:** Rs. 399-999 per candidate (tiered packages)


**Technical Setup Required:** None — self-serve dashboard signup


**Checks Covered:** PAN, UAN/EPFO employment verification, criminal records, education verification, address verification, social media screening, AI-assisted reference checks


**Strengths:**


- **AI-powered reference analysis:** DigiVerifier uses AI to analyse reference check responses, flagging inconsistencies and scoring credibility automatically. This saves HR teams from manually evaluating each reference.
- **Social media screening:** Scans public social media profiles for red flags — an increasingly important check for client-facing and brand-sensitive roles that most BGV tools do not offer.
- **Candidate-friendly flow:** Candidates receive a link to upload documents and complete consent digitally. No paper forms, no email chains.
- **Self-serve signup:** HR managers can create an account and start verifying without a sales call or demo, similar to SalaryBox Verify.


**Limitations:**


- **Limited Voter ID and DL coverage:** DigiVerifier’s focus is PAN, EPFO, criminal, and education checks. Voter ID and Driving Licence verification may not be available in standard packages or may have limited depth compared to SalaryBox Verify’s direct government database queries.
- **Not instant for most checks:** Identity checks return in hours, but criminal records, education verification, and reference checks take 24-48 hours.
- **AI features may overcomplicate simple needs:** If you just need to confirm a candidate’s PAN and employment history, DigiVerifier’s AI reference analysis and social media screening are features you are paying for but may never use.
- **Higher cost for comprehensive packages:** The Rs. 999 package with full AI features costs double SalaryBox Verify’s Rs. 499 for fewer government database checks.


**Best for:** Small businesses (10-100 employees) with dedicated HR staff who value AI-powered insights and social media screening alongside standard verification.


**Verdict:** DigiVerifier adds innovative AI features (reference analysis, social media screening) that no other platform on this list offers. For straightforward government database verification (PAN + Voter ID + DL + EPFO), SalaryBox Verify is faster (instant vs. 24-48 hours), more comprehensive on ID types, and more affordable (Rs. 499 vs. Rs. 399-999).

### 5. Compose1 Verify — Simple Browser-Based BGV for First-Time Users


**Website:**[compose1.com](https://www.compose1.com/)


**Pricing:** Rs. 299-599 per candidate (Basic and Standard tiers)


**Technical Setup Required:** None — designed as the simplest possible entry point for verification


**Checks Covered:** PAN verification, basic employment history verification, limited identity checks (Voter ID and DL coverage may vary), address verification


**Strengths:**


- **Lowest bundled starting price:** At Rs. 299 per candidate for the Basic tier, Compose1 Verify has the lowest entry price among platforms that offer more than just API access.
- **Intentionally simple interface:** No overwhelming dashboards or complex feature sets. Enter candidate details, select checks, get results. Designed for people who have never run a background check before.
- **Zero onboarding friction:** Self-serve signup with no sales call, no demo, and no account configuration. Start checking candidates within minutes.
- **Good entry point for first-time BGV:** Compose1 positions itself for companies moving from zero verification to a structured process for the first time.


**Limitations:**


- **Narrower government database coverage:** Voter ID and Driving Licence verification may not be available in all packages or may have limited detail compared to SalaryBox Verify’s direct queries to ECI and Parivahan/Sarathi databases.
- **Limited UAN/EPFO depth:** Employment verification may rely on reference-based methods rather than direct EPFO queries. For catching fabricated employers, SalaryBox Verify’s EPFO check is more reliable.
- **Newer platform with evolving features:** Compose1 is still building out its capability set. Some checks that SalaryBox Verify and SpringVerify offer may not yet be available.
- **Basic tier may feel too thin:** At Rs. 299, you get basic identity checks. For comprehensive government database coverage (PAN + Voter ID + DL + EPFO), you may need the Rs. 599 tier, at which point SalaryBox Verify’s Rs. 499 offers more for less.


**Best for:** Early-stage companies (pre-seed to seed) with fewer than 20 employees running background checks for the first time and wanting the cheapest possible entry point.


**Verdict:** Compose1 is a good starter tool for verification beginners. However, for businesses that want comprehensive government database checks (PAN + Voter ID + DL + EPFO) with instant results and PDF reports, SalaryBox Verify at Rs. 499 delivers deeper verification for a marginal price increase over Compose1’s basic tier.

### 6. DIY Government Portal Checks — Free Manual Verification Anyone Can Run


**Pricing:** Free


**Technical Setup Required:** None — government portals are public websites


**Checks Covered:** PAN status verification, Voter ID lookup, Driving Licence validity, UAN/EPFO membership details (limited without employee login)


**Strengths:**


- **Zero cost:** Every check is completely free. The most budget-friendly option for micro-businesses.
- **Direct government source:** You are querying the same databases that paid platforms query. The data is identical.
- **No account or signup:** Most portals allow public lookups without registration.
- **Full control:** You decide what to check, when to check, and how to document results.


**Limitations:**


- **20-30 minutes per candidate:** Each portal has its own interface, login flow, and CAPTCHA requirements. Running PAN + Voter ID + DL + EPFO for one candidate takes 20-30 minutes across 4 separate websites. SalaryBox Verify runs all four in seconds from one interface.
- **No cross-referencing:** Government portals show individual results. They do not compare names, dates of birth, or other identity signals across databases. You must manually spot discrepancies between PAN and Voter ID records — something SalaryBox Verify does automatically.
- **No PDF reports:** No downloadable verification report. You must screenshot results or manually document findings for your HR files. This creates inconsistent records and audit trail gaps.
- **Limited EPFO access:** The portal requires the employee’s UAN and linked mobile number for full employment history. Without the candidate’s active cooperation, you can only verify basic UAN membership — not the full employer-wise contribution history that SalaryBox Verify reveals.
- **No batch processing:** Each candidate must be verified individually across all four portals. For 10 hires per month, that is 40+ separate manual sessions — 5-8 hours of HR time.
- **Portal downtime and CAPTCHAs:** Government websites frequently experience downtime, slow loading, and CAPTCHA errors. A check that takes 5 minutes when working can take 30 minutes with retries.


**Best for:** Solo founders and micro-businesses (1-5 employees) with zero budget, willing to invest their own time instead of money.


**Verdict:** DIY portal checks are free but enormously time-consuming. A business owner’s time is worth far more than Rs. 499 per candidate. For any business hiring more than 1-2 people per quarter, SalaryBox Verify pays for itself by saving 20-30 minutes per candidate while delivering automated cross-referencing and PDF reports.

### API-Based vs. No-API Platforms: What You Gain and What You Lose


Understanding the trade-offs helps you make an informed decision.


Dimension API-Based Platforms (SurePass, Gridlines, IDfy) No-API Platforms (SalaryBox Verify, SpringVerify, etc.)


**Setup Time** Days to weeks (developer integration) Minutes (browser signup)


**Setup Cost** Rs. 20,000-1,50,000+ (developer hours) Rs. 0 (no development)


**Per-Check Cost** Rs. 1-8 per API call (cheapest at volume) Rs. 299-1,599 per candidate (bundled)


**Customisation** Fully customisable workflows and UI Fixed workflows designed by the platform


**Automation** Can be embedded into ATS, HRMS, or custom tools Manual initiation per candidate (some ATS integrations)


**Database Coverage** 100+ government and proprietary databases 4-10 core checks (identity, employment, criminal, education)


**Reporting** Custom (you build your own reports) Pre-built PDF reports


**Maintenance** Ongoing developer maintenance required Zero maintenance (platform handles updates)


**Scalability** Unlimited (limited only by API rate limits) Unlimited (platform scales on its own)


**Who Can Use It** Only developers or technical staff Anyone — HR, admin, business owner


**When no-API platforms win:**


- You do not have developers on your team
- You need to start verifying candidates today, not in 2 weeks
- Your hiring volume is under 100 per month
- You want a finished product, not building blocks
- You need PDF reports for HR files without building a reporting layer
- Your budget cannot absorb Rs. 50,000-1,50,000 in development costs


**When API platforms win:**


- You have a dedicated engineering team
- You want to embed verification into your own product (an HRMS, an ATS, a lending platform)
- You need access to 50+ government databases beyond the core identity checks
- Your monthly volume exceeds 500 candidates and you need maximum cost efficiency per check
- You need fully custom verification workflows


**The practical recommendation:**


For 90%+ of Indian SMBs, a no-API platform like SalaryBox Verify is the right choice. The core government database checks (PAN, Voter ID, DL, UAN/EPFO) catch the most common fraud types, and the Rs. 499 per-candidate cost is predictable with no hidden development expenses. Reserve API platforms for when your business has both the engineering resources and the verification volume to justify the investment.

### FAQs: No-Developer Employee Verification Platforms


###### 1. What does “no API or developer setup” mean for verification tools?


It means the entire verification process — from creating your account to running checks and downloading reports — happens through a web browser interface that any non-technical person can use. There is no code to write, no API keys to generate, no webhook endpoints to configure, and no developer console to navigate. You sign up, enter candidate details, and get results — just like using any other website.


###### 2. Which no-developer verification platform is best for small businesses in India?


SalaryBox Verify is the best overall choice. At Rs. 499 per candidate, it covers PAN, Voter ID, Driving Licence, and UAN/EPFO verification with instant results and PDF reports. It has the fastest setup (5 minutes), the most comprehensive government database coverage among self-serve tools, and the most predictable pricing — no hidden costs, no minimum volumes, no contracts.


###### 3. Are no-developer platforms less accurate than API-based tools?


No. SalaryBox Verify queries the exact same government databases (Income Tax Department, Election Commission, Parivahan, EPFO) that API platforms like SurePass and Gridlines query. The data source is identical. The difference is in the delivery method (browser interface vs. raw API), not in data quality. A PAN check on SalaryBox Verify returns the same Income Tax Department record as a PAN API call on SurePass.


###### 4. Can I run SalaryBox Verify checks without any technical knowledge?


Yes. The workflow is identical to filling out an online form: enter the candidate’s name and ID numbers, select which checks you want, confirm Rs. 499 billing, and receive results in seconds. If you can use email and fill out a web form, you can use SalaryBox Verify. No training needed.


###### 5. What government databases do no-developer platforms query?


The core government databases for employee verification in India are: PAN (Income Tax Department), Voter ID (Election Commission of India), Driving Licence (Parivahan/Sarathi, Ministry of Road Transport), and UAN/EPFO (Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation). SalaryBox Verify covers all four. Some platforms also add Aadhaar (via OKYC/DigiLocker), GST, and MCA checks, but these are less commonly needed for employee verification.


###### 6. How much do no-developer verification platforms cost compared to API platforms?


No-developer platforms range from free (DIY government portals) to Rs. 1,599 per candidate (SpringVerify Premium). SalaryBox Verify sits at Rs. 499 per candidate. API platforms like SurePass charge Rs. 1-5 per API call, but require Rs. 20,000-1,50,000+ in developer integration costs before you can run your first check. For businesses verifying fewer than 200 candidates per month, no-developer platforms are more cost-effective when you include development costs.


###### 7. Can no-developer platforms handle bulk verification during peak hiring seasons?


Yes. SalaryBox Verify, SpringVerify, and DigiVerifier all scale with your volume without requiring plan changes or technical adjustments. If you hire 3 people in June and 25 people in October, you pay for exactly 3 and 25 respectively. The platform handles the infrastructure scaling automatically.


###### 8. Do I lose any important features by avoiding API-based platforms?


The main things you give up are: custom workflow design (API platforms let you build verification into your own software), access to 100+ niche government databases (most businesses only need PAN, Voter ID, DL, and EPFO), and maximum per-check cost efficiency at very high volumes (500+ per month). For most small businesses, none of these trade-offs matter.


###### 9. Is government database verification through these platforms legally compliant?


Yes. All platforms on this list require candidate consent before running checks. SalaryBox Verify includes a consent step in the billing workflow. Government database verification is inherently compliant with data protection requirements because you are accessing official records with proper authorisation and clear audit trails. Each verification generates a timestamped record of what was checked and when.


###### 10. Can I switch from a no-developer platform to an API platform later?


Yes, and this is actually the recommended approach. Start with SalaryBox Verify at Rs. 499/candidate to verify hires immediately with zero setup cost. When your business grows to 200+ hires per month and you hire a developer team, evaluate whether building a custom API integration makes economic sense. There is no lock-in, no data migration needed, and no penalty for switching. Your existing verification records stay in your SalaryBox Verify workspace regardless.
